I tore this meal DOWN ——————————————— RECIPEEEE! If y'all been following me y'all know I do not measure but i'll try my best.  Ingredients:  - Russet Potatoes  - Heavy Cream - Colby Jack Cheese - Seasonings for taste (in step list)  - Sharp Cheddar Cheese  - Unsalted Butter  - Vegetable Oil - Broccoli (optional for filling) - Aluminum Foil - Garlic Paste  - Sour Cream - EVOO - Cubed Chicken (cut up breasts or tenderloin)  [Baked Potato] * 1st you want to prep your potatoes. Bake in the oven at 400 degrees F for about an hour. * Once potatoes are soft and cooked completely remove the foil and cut down the middle of each potato, hot dog style. Scoop out the inside of the potato and put into an empty mixing bowl. To the mixing bowl you're going to add 1 stick of unsalted melted butter, tbsp of garlic paste, parsley, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp garlic salt, cooked broccoli, 1/2c grated sharp cheddar cheese, pepper, and 2 tbsp sour cream. Mix together and scoop filling back into potatoes. [Sauce]  * Add 1 tbsp butter to pan, 1 tsp garlic paste and parsley and melt down. Add about 1cup of heavy cream and let cook for 5 minutes to thicken. Add pepper, onion powder and lawrys seasoning salt to season. Add colby jack cheese (about 1cup) and mix until sauce is thick and consistency you like. [Chicken]  * I used chicken beasts and cut into cubes. Add EVOO and seasoned with parsley, onion powder, garlic powder and adobo. Cooked in a greased pan until done. * Add thin layer of sauce on potatoes, then chicken, then sauce again and finally top with more cheese and bake on 125 until cheese is melted. #loadedpotato #twicebakedpotato #chickenloadedpotato #cookingtiktok #chefd #fivestarmeals #dinnerideas #dinnerinspo

Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

Three ingredient 🍋 Lemon Posset  UPDATE: This recipe requires these 3 exact ingredients to work. They interact and cause a chemical reaction to get the end result. If you use a different style sweetener it may not set. If you need a dairy alternative I'd encourage you to look up a vegan version of this dish as it would require other ingredients to work.  Here’s what you need👇 4 large Lemons for juice and cups (6 tbsp of juice) 2 cups Heavy Cream (this cannot be substituted for anything else- it's essential for the recipe) 1/2 cup Granulated Sugar 1 tbsp Lemon Zest *I topped mine with decorative sugar and a raspberry* Prepare the Lemon Cups: Cut the lemons in half widthwise. Using a spoon or small knife, carefully scoop out the flesh and juice, being careful not to puncture the rind. Save the inside flesh of the lemon, squeeze out the juices and strain into a bowl or cup and set it aside for the filling. Set the halved lemon cups onto a tray or plate so they are sitting upright and are stable. Make the Lemon Posset: In a medium saucepan over medium heat, combine the heavy cream, sugar, and lemon zest (if using). Stir occasionally and bring to a gentle simmer. Let it bubble lightly for 3 minutes, stirring frequently. Remove the pan from heat and slowly whisk in the lemon juice. The mixture will begin to thicken naturally as you do this. Fill and Chill: Carefully pour the warm posset into the prepared lemon cups (or into small jars if not using the cups). It helps to add the lemon posset filling into a liquid measuring cup with a pour spout for easier transfer. Let them cool at room temperature for about 30 minutes, then refrigerate for at least 2.5-3 hours or until fully set. Before serving, you can garnish with sanding sugar and a berry if desired. #lemonposset #lemon #easydessert #brunch #easterrecipes #mothersdayideas

Arayes 🥙 This is one of the best Mediterranean meals you can easily make at home in about 30 minutes. Crispy pita stuffed with seasoned beef, cooked until golden, and finished with a creamy garlic sauce. If you’re always looking for new dinner ideas, you’re in the right place. That’s why I share simple and affordable meals that save you time and money. Follow for more weeknight staples. Ingredients Meat Mixture • 1 lb ground beef (85/15) • 1 small yellow onion, grated and squeezed dry • 5 garlic cloves, finely grated • 1 grated jalapeño • 2 tbsp tomato paste • ⅓ cup parsley, finely chopped • ¼ cup cilantro, finely chopped • 1 tbsp olive oil • 1 tbsp ice water • 1 tsp salt • 1 tsp black pepper • 2 tsp cumin • 2 tsp paprika • 1 tsp allspice • 1 tsp coriander • 1 tsp garlic powder • ¼ tsp cinnamon Other • 4 pitas, cut in half Garlic Tahini Yogurt Sauce • ¾ cup Greek yogurt • ¼ cup tahini • 3 garlic cloves, finely grated • Juice of ½ lemon • 1 tbsp olive oil • ½ tsp salt • ¼ tsp cumin • 2 tbsp parsley, finely chopped • 2 tbsp cilantro, finely chopped Instructions 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. 2. In a large bowl, mix together the beef, grated onion, garlic, jalapeño, tomato paste, parsley, cilantro, olive oil, ice water, and spices until fully combined and slightly sticky. 3. Cut the pitas in half and gently open each pocket (heat the pitas in the microwave for a few seconds first to make them easier to open). Spread a thin layer of the meat mixture inside each pita, then brush the outside generously with olive oil. 4. Heat a pan over medium heat. Cook the arayes meat side down first for 1–2 minutes until charred, then flip and cook each pita side until golden and crispy. 5. Finish in the oven for 15 minutes, or until the meat reaches 155°F internally. 6. While the arayes cook, mix together all sauce ingredients until smooth. 7. Brush the hot arayes with olive oil mixed with minced garlic and parsley, then serve with the dipping sauce. #easydinners #arayes #pita

MARRY ME MASH 🥔✨ Recipe below ⬇️ This is the ultimate recipe for luxurious mashed potato. Ultra-smooth, buttery, garlic-thyme infused, finished with white pepper and nutmeg. Make no mistake - this is pure indulgence, and it will make your guests so silent at the table. Marry Me Mash: Peel and cube 1kg Maris Piper potatoes. Add to cold salted water, bring to the boil, then simmer gently until completely tender. Drain and leave to steam dry for 20-30 minutes (this step is key for texture). Meanwhile, gently simmer 200ml whole milk and 200ml double cream with 4 chopped garlic cloves and 3-4 thyme sprigs for 30 minutes to infuse. Strain and keep warm. Pass the dried potatoes through a ricer, then fold through 150g melted butter. For extra smoothness, push through a fine mesh sieve. Add the warm infused cream one ladle at a time until silky and smooth but still holding its shape. Season with fine salt, white pepper and a small grating of nutmeg. Taste and adjust. Bonus recipe - Braised Short Rib (perfect with this mash): Season 3-4 large beef short ribs generously with salt and pepper and sear in a hot casserole pot with 1 tbsp oil until deeply browned. Remove. In the same pot soften 1 diced onion, 2 diced celery sticks and 2 diced carrots. Add 2 tbsp tomato purée, 3 sliced garlic cloves, 3 thyme sprigs and 2 bay leaves. Deglaze with 500ml red wine, reduce slightly, then add enough beef stock (around 750ml-1L) to fully submerge the ribs. Return the ribs, cover and cook at 130°C for 4 hours until spoon tender. Remove the ribs, strain and remove the fat from the sauce (use a separator jug if you have one). Pass through a fine sieve and then reduce it until glossy and thick enough to coat the back of a spoon. Return the ribs to the sauce and baste. Silky mash. Sticky, rich beef. Absolute comfort food - elevated. #mash #shortrib #cooking #recipe #food

How to Make Steak Tartare 🥩 - THE TARTARE SERIES ep. 1  FULL RECIPE BELOW ⬇️  INGREDIENTS: - 250g beef (SEE NOTES BELOW ON CHOOSING THE RIGHT CUT) - 1/2 small shallot - 1 tbsp chopped gherkin pickles - 1 tbsp chopped capers - 1 tbsp chopped parsley - 1/4 bunch chives  - 1 tsp Dijon mustard - 1 tbsp lemon - 2 tbsp olive oil - tobasco, Worcestershire to taste - salt and fresh cracked pepper to taste - 1 large russet potato  - 1L canola oil (for frying) - 1 head gem lettuce - 1 egg yolk NOTES ON CHOOSING THE RIGHT CUT: - I recommend going to your local butcher, and asking which cut they recommend for tartare. A reputable butcher is one that receives whole animals, or primal cuts that they break down themselves.  - DO NOT use pre-ground beef for tartare. Ground beef has much more surface area that can be exposed to bacteria, and can also get contaminated through the grinding process. Make sure you buy a whole cut of beef, and cut/grind it yourself.  - Buy your beef the same day you intend to make tartare, and make sure your beef stays cold! I recommend bringing a cooler bag with ice packs to the butcher.  - If there is harmful bacteria on a cut of beef (although the risk is very low if you follow the above steps), it will live on the outside of the cut. If you want to be EXTRA safe when eating tartare, you can quickly sear the outside of your steak in a hot pan, and cut off the seared portion. I personally don’t do this, but this could give some people some extra piece of mind.  - You are looking for a cut that is lean, with no excess fat or marbling. Tenderloin will be more tender, and on the more expensive side. Cuts like the top round, inside round etc, will be more chewy, but also less expensive. I used top round for the tartare in this video.  INSTRUCTIONS: TARTARE: 🥩 1) Thinly slice your beef approx. 3 mm thick, and lay the strips on a sheet pan lined with parchment paper. Place the tray in the freezer until beef is semi-frozen. 2) While waiting for your beef to freeze, finely chop your shallot, gherkins, capers, and parsley. Finely chop your chives and set aside. 3) When your beef is semi-frozen, dice it into approx. 3mm dice. While you are dicing, keep your beef on the frozen tray, as it will keep it cold.  4) In a large chilled bowl, mix your Dijon, lemon juice, and olive oil, along with a few dashes of tobasco and Worcestershire. Keep whisking until the dressing has emulsified. Add your beef to the bowl, along with your shallots, parsley, gherkins and capers. Season with salt and freshly cracked pepper. Taste your tartare and adjust seasoning.  5) Plate your tartare on a chilled plate, garnish with chives and your egg yolk. Serve with potato chips and lettuce leaves. POTATO CHIPS 🥔 1) Preheat a pot of canola oil to 300 degrees Fahrenheit. 2) Thinly slice your potatoes lengthwise on a mandolin approx 1mm thick, being sure to keep the thickness as constant as possible. Soak your chips in cold water, changing the water 3-4 times until clear.  3) Remove your chips from the water, and pat them dry with paper towel.  4) Working in small batches, fry your potato chips, stirring often, ensuring your chips stay submerged as best as possible (you might have to press them down with a slotted spoon or strainer). 5) When your chips are just slightly golden (do not wait until they are brown - as they will taste bitter), remove them from the oil, and season them with fine sea salt. Place them on a tray lined with paper towel for oil to drain easily off chips. #steak #tartare #beef #recipe #homecooking

MEATBALL SUB BITES! Homemade meatballs tossed in pizza sauce, then wrapped up in pizza dough with mozzarella and baked until golden brown, then brushed with butter, parm & parsley. And warm pizza sauce for dipping. It’s game day season and these are the perfect 2-bite app that we’re 100% sure everyone will love!!  Full recipe at: https://www.crowdedkitchen.com/meatball-sub-bites/ 1 lb 80/20 ground beef ½ cup Italian-seasoned breadcrumbs ½ cup whole milk 1 large egg ⅓ cup grated parmesan cheese 2 garlic cloves grated ¾ teaspoon kosher salt ½ teaspoon black pepper 8 ounces pizza dough 12 ounces pizza sauce divided ½ cup low-moisture mozzarella shredded 2 tablespoons melted butter for brushing Grated parmesan for topping Chopped parsley for topping Preheat your oven to 425˚F. To a small mixing bowl, add the breadcrumbs and milk together, stir, and let the mixture rest for five minutes. It should look like thick oatmeal, so add milk a tablespoon at a time if it looks dry. To a large mixing bowl, add the ground beef, panade, egg, parmesan, garlic, salt, and pepper. Mix gently by hand just until combined. Using a 3 tablespoon scoop, scoop into 14 meatballs and roll them into shape. Bake the meatballs 425°F for about 15 minutes. Slightly underbaked is fine; they'll be going back into the oven later. Toss the meatballs in about 4 ounces of the pizza sauce, setting the other half of the sauce aside for dipping later. They should be coated, not drenched. Cut the dough. Roll to ~12×10" and cut into squares. Grease a muffin tin. To make one of the meatball sub bites, add a square of pizza dough into one of the muffin slots, then place a pinch of shredded mozzarella on the bottom, a saucy meatball on top, and a pinch more mozzarella over it. Gather the corners over the top of the meatball, one at a time. Bake at 400°F for about 18-20 minutes, until deep golden and 160°F+ in the center. Brush with butter and parmesan before serving.

Sticky Chicken Tender, seasoned chicken coated in a sweet and savory sticky sauce, served over warm rice and finished with green onions and sesame seeds. Ingredients For the Chicken 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 teaspoon each onion powder, garlic powder, and teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon each black pepper and paprika  2 tablespoons olive oil About ⅓ cup cornstarch Olive oil, for cooking For the Sticky Sauce ½ cup soy sauce ⅓ cup brown sugar or honey 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce 1 tablespoon ketchup 1 teaspoon ginger paste ½ tablespoon minced garlic 1 tablespoon cornstarch 2 tablespoons butter For Serving Cooked white rice Sliced green onions Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Add the chicken to a large bowl and season with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and toss until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Sprinkle about ⅓ cup cornstarch over the seasoned chicken and toss until each piece is lightly and evenly coated. This helps give the chicken that tender, velvety texture and creates a great coating for the sauce. 3. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar or honey, hoisin sauce, ketchup, ginger paste, minced garlic, and 1½ tablespoons cornstarch until smooth. Set aside. 4. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken in 2 batches so you don't overcrowd the pan. Cook until golden brown on the outside and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. 5. Reduce the heat and add 2 tablespoons of butter to the same skillet, scraping up all those flavorful browned bits from the bottom of the pan. 6. Pour the prepared sauce into the skillet. Cook over low heat, whisking frequently, until the sauce begins to bubble and thickens into a glossy, sticky consistency. 7. Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and toss until every piece is completely coated in the sticky sauce. 8. Spoon the sticky chicken over warm rice and finish with sliced green onion.  #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #quickrecipes #easydinner #dinnerrecipes
